title: crataegus × media f. laciniata
intro: Crataegus × media f. laciniata, commonly known as hawthorn, is a hybrid plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is primarily known for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus × media f. laciniata include acting as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its cardiovascular benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
